standard_carryon_dimensions.value: 22 x 14 x 9 in (56 x 36 x 23 cm), including handles and wheels
standard_carryon_dimensions.notes: Official carry-on page: the bag must fit the airport sizer and cannot exceed these dimensions. Verified against the archived article body.

standard_piece_weight.notes: Official checked-baggage policy standard weight limit. Allowance and fees still vary by fare and itinerary.

premium_piece_weight.value: 70 lb (32 kg) per free bag in First and Business
premium_piece_weight.notes: Official checked-baggage policy. Excess charged bags retain the standard 50 lb / 23 kg threshold.

online_checkin_window.value: Online or app check-in opens 24 hours before departure
online_checkin_window.notes: The closing time depends on itinerary and airport; use the separate cutoff fields.

us_checkin_cutoff.value: 45 minutes before departure for most flights within the US
us_checkin_cutoff.notes: Some named airports require earlier check-in.

international_checkin_cutoff.value: 60 minutes before departure for most flights to or from destinations outside the US
international_checkin_cutoff.notes: Some named airports require 75, 90 or 120 minutes.
